links.comparator_used: ChatGPT's original response to each question, before the follow-up request to simplify
links.outcome: Reading grade level of responses (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level)
links.effect: Easier responses had a mean FKGL of 11.14 (95% CI 10.57 to 11.71) versus 12.15 (95% CI 11.45 to 12.85) for original responses (t = 2.204; p = 0.029).
links.quote: There was a significantly lower FKGL (t = 2.204; p = 0.029) for easier responses (11.14; 95% CI 10.57 to 11.71) than original responses (12.15; 95% CI 11.45 to 12.85).
